subject: Vendor onboarding: security docs & PO instructions
messages:
From: Matthew Lewis <matthew.lewis@blueharbor.com>
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@blueharbor.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor kickoff — security docs and PO details

Hi David,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Procurement at BlueHarbor is starting the vendor activation for Redwood and asked me to gather the standard security & purchasing artifacts so we can move to PO issuance. Can you please send the following: 

- Our redlineable DPA (we usually ask for a sample or the standard DPA PDF)
- SOC 2 report or a link to a hosted SOC 2 evidence portal (read-only link is fine)
- Current subprocessor list (spreadsheet preferred)
- Any standard PO instructions (billing contact, remit address, tax info)

Do you have an estimated timeline for providing those? We aim to have a PO issued (net-30) by end of next week.

Also copying procurement@blueharbor.com for their intake.

Appreciate it —
Matt Lewis
Contracts & Procurement
BlueHarbor Inc.

---
Attachments: none
From: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Matthew Lewis <matthew.lewis@blueharbor.com>, procurement@blueharbor.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff — security docs and PO details

Matt —

Great to connect earlier. See below and attached items to start the activation:

- Attached: Redwood_DPA_BlueHarbor_v1.2.pdf — our standard DPA (PDF). We’re happy to review limited redlines; please flag any clauses you intend to change.
- SOC 2: secure link to our report: https://redwood-storage.example.com/soc2/reports/redwood-soc2-2025.html (read-only, access expires in 30 days).
- Subprocessors: attached spreadsheet 'subprocessors_list_202506.xlsx' with current vendor categories and data centers.
- PO instructions: attached PO_Instructions_BH-2025-0017.pdf (billing email, remit address, W-9).

We generally respond to DPA redlines within 2 business days for standard requests. For PO/finance questions, Monica on procurement ops can help finalize invoicing details (cc'd).

Next steps I propose:
1) BlueHarbor reviews attached DPA and returns any redlines to laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
2) Procurement confirms billing contact and PO reference and sends us DocuSign link (if you use that)
3) Once DPA is agreed we’ll provision vendor in our portal and confirm go-live window

If you prefer, I can also share a short spreadsheet with sample SLOs and routing policies we apply for production tenants.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_BlueHarbor_v1.2.pdf, subprocessors_list_202506.xlsx, PO_Instructions_BH-2025-0017.pdf
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: david.kim@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor kickoff — security docs and PO details

David / Monica —

Thanks for the heads-up. I pulled the DPA and took a first pass. High-level notes:

- Section 4.2 (Data Processing Scope): ok but would prefer a little more specificity around subprocessor notification timing. Suggest adding 'within 10 business days' for material changes.
- Security controls: our SOC 2 link looks recent; confirm the report date and what regions are covered (I’ll ask security).
- Liability caps: BlueHarbor may request a reciprocal cap; we should hold firm with our standard carveouts.

Monica — can you confirm the remit address in the PO instructions and whether accounting needs an alternate tax form for BlueHarbor? If so, we'll coordinate.

I'll prepare a brief redline bundle for David to share back to Matt. If their procurement wants to negotiate anything material we should loop Legal Ops.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: none
From: david.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Matthew Lewis <matthew.lewis@blueharbor.com>, procurement@blueharbor.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff — security docs and PO details

Matt —

Following up with the updated materials. Laura confirmed a small clarifying edit (notification timing) which we've annotated in the DPA; the attached PDF shows the comment thread for your legal team. A few notes: 

- DPA: 'Redwood_DPA_BlueHarbor_v1.2.pdf' (annotated). If you have redlines please return as a PDF or via DocuSign markup.
- SOC 2 link (same as before): https://redwood-storage.example.com/soc2/reports/redwood-soc2-2025.html — report date: 2025-04-30; covers US and EU data centers.
- Subprocessors: 'subprocessors_list_202506.xlsx' is current as of 2025-06-01. We will notify customers for any material additions within 10 business days.
- PO/Finance: Monica confirms remit address in the PO_Instructions_BH-2025-0017.pdf is correct for net-30 billing; accounting prefers the DocuSign PO route.

If everything looks good we can accept a signed DPA and the DocuSign PO to complete vendor activation. I’ve included a DocuSign link sample below for your procurement team to use: https://app.docusign.com/po/BH-2025-0017/sign

Let me know if you want a short sync to walk a technical contact through our onboarding checklist (provisioning, API keys, routing policy). Happy to schedule 30 minutes next week.

Best,
David Kim
Senior GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
